title: Open Format Shape Pane (TextAndFormat)

scenarios.title: Open Format Shape Pane applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Open Format Shape Pane (BtnFormatShapeDialog) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Effect-removal context actions clear exactly their effects (and RemoveAll clears all five)
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host the deterministic effect-removal context-menu actions run on a fixture with a shadow+glow+soft-edge shape, a reflection+threeD shape and a plain control: an individual action removes only its own effect (glow and soft edges survive RemoveShadow), RemoveAllEffects clears all five effects - the shadow is cleared last so the theme-shadow re-apply that glow/soft-edge removal can trigger does not survive (REG-FORMATSHAPE-ALLFX-001) - RemoveReflection leaves threeD intact and vice versa, the plain control stays untouched, the run reports execution and writes no new %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log entry.
